units.source_text: 是年秋末，八亲王举办每年四季例行的念佛会。

en.t: At the end of autumn that year, the Eighth Prince held the nenbutsu service that he customarily held each season.

units.source_text: 此时宇治川边鱼梁上水波声特别嘈杂，片刻不静，

en.t: At this time, the sound of the water over the fish weir by the Uji River was especially loud and never quiet for a moment,

units.source_text: 因此念佛会移往阿阇梨所居山寺中佛堂里举行，定期七日。

en.t: so the nenbutsu service was moved to the Buddha hall of the mountain temple where the acharya lived, and was set to last seven days.

units.source_text: 亲王去后，两位女公子更加寂寥，每天只是闲坐沉思。

en.t: After the prince had gone, the two young ladies felt even lonelier, and each day they merely sat idly, lost in thought.

units.source_text: 此时中将薰君久不访问宇治，挂念八亲王，

en.t: Around then, Lieutenant General Kaoru had not visited Uji for a long time, and he became concerned about the Eighth Prince,

units.source_text: 便在一天深夜残月未沉之时动身，

en.t: so late one night, while the waning moon had not yet set, he set out,

units.source_text: 照例悄悄出门，随从也不多带，微服入山。

en.t: leaving quietly as usual, taking only a few attendants with him, and entering the mountains in private dress.

units.source_text: 八亲王的山庄位在宇治川这边岸上，

en.t: The Eighth Prince's mountain villa stood on this side of the Uji River,

units.source_text: 不烦舟楫渡河，骑马可以到达。

en.t: so there was no need to trouble with a boat crossing, and it could be reached on horseback.
The deeper he went into the mountains, the thicker the clouds and mist became.

units.source_text: 草木繁茂，几乎掩蔽道路。

en.t: The grasses and trees grew so thickly that they almost hid the road.

units.source_text: 山风狂吹，木叶上露珠纷纷散落。

en.t: The mountain wind blew fiercely, and drops of dew scattered down from the leaves.

units.source_text: 由于心情关系，露珠着袖似觉寒气逼人。

en.t: Perhaps because of his mood, when the dew touched his sleeves it seemed to bring a piercing chill.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得此种行旅平生极少经历，

en.t: Kaoru felt that he had rarely experienced such a journey in all his life,

units.source_text: 一面不胜凄凉，一面又感兴趣。

en.t: and while he was overcome by desolation, he also found it strangely engaging.
